lessons.title: zh, ch, sh, j, q, x

units.title: I want, I have, I like

items.en: I don't have an older brother.
How old are you? (to a child)
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The milk is in the kitchen.
I can speak a little Chinese.
What do you do for work?
Do you have a bigger one?
a table for two (lit. two people)
I'd like a cup of coffee.

items.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ
items.en: Please give me a glass of water.
I take the subway to work.

items.text: 我和家人一起吃了晚饭
items.pinyin: wǒ hé jiārén yìqǐ chī le wǎnfàn
items.en: I had dinner with my family.

items.pinyin: wǒ kàn le yí bù diànyǐng
wǒ yì zhěng tiān dōu zài jiā
cóngqián yǒu yí ge xiǎo nǚhái
items.en: Once upon a time there was a little girl.

items.pinyin: tā zhù zài yí ge xiǎo cūnzi li
items.en: She lived in a small village.

items.pinyin: tā měitiān dōu qù hé biān
items.en: Every day she went to the river.

items.text: 有一天，她找到了一个盒子
items.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān, tā zhǎodào le yí ge hézi
items.en: One day she found a box.

items.text: 从此他们过上了幸福的生活
items.pinyin: cóngcǐ tāmen guò shàng le xìngfú de shēnghuó
items.en: And from then on they lived happily ever after.

items.pinyin: tā zhǎng de xiàng tā māma

items.text: 我做饭的时候，电话响了
items.pinyin: wǒ zuòfàn de shíhou, diànhuà xiǎng le
items.en: While I was cooking, the phone rang.

items.text: 我到的时候，他已经走了
items.pinyin: wǒ dào de shíhou, tā yǐjīng zǒu le
items.en: When I arrived, he had already left.
I'm going to be a little late.

items.pinyin: nǐ néng gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà ma?
wǒ wǎn diǎnr gěi nǐ fā xiāoxi

items.en: Let me know when you get there.

items.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng lái wǒ de pàiduì ma?
items.en: Do you want to come to my party?

items.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ qù bu liǎo

items.en: How about going to see a movie?
Let's meet at eight in the square.

items.text: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里
items.pinyin: rúguǒ xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù dāi zài jiā li
items.en: If it rains, we'll stay home.
I have a meeting at ten.
The report is due before Friday.

items.pinyin: wǒ yǒu wǔ nián de xiāoshòu jīngyàn
items.en: I have five years of experience in sales.

items.text: 你为什么想做这个工作？
items.pinyin: nǐ wèishénme xiǎng zuò zhège gōngzuò?
items.en: Why do you want this job?
I have to pay the rent.

items.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kāi yí ge yínháng zhànghù
items.en: I'd like to open a bank account.

items.pinyin: wǒ zài zǎn qián qù lǚxíng
items.en: I'm saving up for a trip.

items.pinyin: nǐ duō shōu le wǒ de qián

items.en: I've had a fever since yesterday.

items.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng guà ge hào kàn yīshēng
items.en: I'd like to register to see a doctor.
I'm worried about my older brother.
I've been under a lot of stress lately.
I'm really embarrassed. / I'm so sorry.
You should get some good rest.

items.text: 要是我是你，我会去看医生
items.pinyin: yàoshi wǒ shì nǐ, wǒ huì qù kàn yīshēng
items.en: If I were you, I'd go to the doctor.

items.pinyin: wǒ jiànyì nǐ duō shuì yìdiǎnr
items.en: I suggest you sleep a bit more.
You'd better drink lots of water.

items.pinyin: hángbān yánwù le liǎng ge xiǎoshí
items.en: The flight is delayed two hours.

items.pinyin: néng gěi wǒ huàn yí ge hángbān ma?
items.en: Can you change me to another flight?

items.pinyin: néng bāng wǒ huàn ge fángjiān ma?
items.en: Could you move me to another room?
I want to speak to your manager.

items.pinyin: zhè bú shì wǒ yùdìng de
wǒ de qiánbāo bèi tōu le

items.en: I want to call the police.

items.text: 失业率连续三个月下降
items.pinyin: shīyèlǜ liánxù sān ge yuè xiàjiàng
items.en: Unemployment fell for the third month in a row.

items.text: 成千上万的人走上街头
items.pinyin: chéngqiān shàngwàn de rén zǒushàng jiētóu
items.en: Thousands of people took to the streets.

items.text: 你听说了吗？部长辞职了
items.pinyin: nǐ tīngshuō le ma? bùzhǎng cízhí le
items.en: Did you hear? The minister resigned.

items.pinyin: jù zhuānjiā shuō, qíngkuàng huì gèng zāo
items.en: According to experts, the situation will get worse.

items.text: 我昨晚在新闻上看到的
items.pinyin: wǒ zuówǎn zài xīnwén shang kàndào de
items.en: I saw it on the news last night.
I hear there'll be a strike on Monday.
You have to check where the news comes from.

items.pinyin: wǒ rènwéi zhè shì ge cuòwù
items.en: I believe this is a mistake.

items.pinyin: wǒ juéde nǐ shuō de duì

items.text: 在我看来，还有更重要的事
items.pinyin: zài wǒ kànlái, hái yǒu gèng zhòngyào de shì
items.en: The way I see it, there are more important things.

items.pinyin: nà yào kàn nǐ zěnme kàn
items.en: That depends on how you look at it.

items.text: 我明白你的意思，但是我不这么看
items.pinyin: wǒ míngbai nǐ de yìsi, dànshì wǒ bú zhème kàn
items.en: I see what you mean, but I don't see it that way.

items.pinyin: zhè yì diǎn nǐ shuō de duì
zài mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shang shì zhèyàng

items.en: On the one hand, it's cheaper.

items.pinyin: lìng yì fāngmiàn, wūrǎn gèng yánzhòng
items.en: On the other hand, it pollutes more.
We have to take the cost into account.
Although it's hard, it's worth it.
The data show exactly the opposite.

items.text: 设想一下，如果这发生在你身上呢？
items.pinyin: shèxiǎng yíxià, rúguǒ zhè fāshēng zài nǐ shēnshang ne?
items.en: Imagine if this happened to you.

items.text: 这不是钱的问题，而是原则的问题
items.pinyin: zhè bú shì qián de wèntí, ér shì yuánzé de wèntí
items.en: It's not a question of money, but of principle.
In short, we need a change.
Finally, I'd like to thank everyone.
Sorry to trouble you, could you help me?

items.text: 如能尽快回复，不胜感激
items.pinyin: rú néng jǐnkuài huífù, búshèng gǎnjī
items.en: I would be most grateful for a prompt reply. (written)
Excuse me, where is the office?

items.pinyin: néng gěi wǒ lái bēi kāfēi ma?

items.text: 我写信是想向您咨询一些情况
items.pinyin: wǒ xiě xìn shì xiǎng xiàng nín zīxún yìxiē qíngkuàng
items.en: I am writing to ask you for some information.
I look forward to your reply.
kill two birds with one stone
when in Rome, do as the Romans do
to overdo it (lit. draw legs on a snake)
to waste your words (lit. play the lute to a cow)

items.pinyin: shuō qǐlai róngyì, zuò qǐlai nán
sài wēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú
items.en: A loss may turn out to be a blessing.

items.pinyin: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
items.en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

items.pinyin: jìn zhū zhě chì, jìn mò zhě hēi
items.en: You are the company you keep.

items.pinyin: rén wài yǒu rén, tiān wài yǒu tiān

items.en: to watch the drama unfold (lit. eat melon)
to opt out of the rat race (lit. lie flat)
That got to me. / I'm emotionally wrecked.

items.text: 好久不见！最近忙什么呢？
items.pinyin: hǎojiǔ bú jiàn! zuìjìn máng shénme ne?
items.en: Long time no see! What have you been up to?

items.text: 听到你过得好，我很高兴
items.pinyin: tīngdào nǐ guò de hǎo, wǒ hěn gāoxìng
items.en: I'm glad to hear you're doing well.

items.pinyin: gǎitiān yìqǐ chī ge fàn ba
items.en: Let's get a meal together sometime.
It turned out he had forgotten.
In the end, we missed the train.

items.text: 更糟糕的是，开始下雨了
items.pinyin: gèng zāogāo de shì, kāishǐ xià yǔ le
items.en: Worse still, it started to rain.

items.pinyin: hǎozài zuìhòu dōu tǐng shùnlì de
items.en: Luckily, in the end it all went smoothly.

items.pinyin: nǐ dǒng wǒ de yìsi ma?
items.en: Do you get what I mean?

items.text: 你跟小雨是怎么认识的？
items.pinyin: Nǐ gēn Xiǎoyǔ shì zěnme rènshi de?
Zhèr de yīnyuè tǐng búcuò de.
items.en: The music here is pretty good.

items.pinyin: Nǐ de chuāndā hěn yǒu pǐnwèi.

items.en: You look really nice when you smile.
Oh, not at all. Thank you.

items.pinyin: Gǎitiān yìqǐ hē bēi kāfēi ba?
items.en: Shall we get a coffee together sometime?

items.text: 周六一起去看电影怎么样？
items.pinyin: Zhōuliù yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
items.en: How about seeing a movie together on Saturday?

items.text: 这周末不行，下周末可以吗？
items.pinyin: Zhè zhōumò bù xíng, xià zhōumò kěyǐ ma?
items.en: This weekend doesn't work. How about next weekend?

items.text: 谢谢，不过我已经有对象了。
items.pinyin: Xièxie, búguò wǒ yǐjīng yǒu duìxiàng le.
items.en: Thanks, but I'm already seeing someone.

items.text: 谢谢你，不过我觉得我们还是当朋友吧。
items.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, búguò wǒ juéde wǒmen háishi dāng péngyou ba.
items.en: Thank you, but I think we should just be friends.

items.pinyin: Dào jiā le, jīnwǎn hěn kāixīn.
items.en: Home now. Had a great time tonight ❤️
Sorry, I only just saw your message 🙈
Why did you leave me on read?

items.text: 你和狗的照片太可爱了🐶
items.pinyin: Nǐ hé gǒu de zhàopiàn tài kě'ài le.
items.en: Your photo with the dog is so cute 🐶
items.say: 你和狗的照片太可爱了。

items.text: 你做过最疯狂的事是什么？
items.pinyin: Nǐ zuò guo zuì fēngkuáng de shì shì shénme?
items.en: What's the craziest thing you've ever done?

items.text: 要不要见个面，喝杯咖啡？
items.pinyin: Yào bu yào jiàn ge miàn, hē bēi kāfēi?
items.en: Want to meet up for a coffee?

items.text: 我现在不想认真谈恋爱。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bù xiǎng rènzhēn tán liàn'ài.
items.en: I'm not looking for anything serious right now.

items.text: 你人很好，但是我觉得我们不太来电。
items.pinyin: Nǐ rén hěn hǎo, dànshì wǒ juéde wǒmen bú tài láidiàn.
items.en: You're really nice, but I don't think we have chemistry.

items.pinyin: Gēn nǐ zài yìqǐ wǒ hěn zìzai.
items.en: I feel really at ease with you.

items.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng xǐhuan shang nǐ le.
items.en: I think I've fallen for you.

items.text: 我想知道，我们现在算什么关系？
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào, wǒmen xiànzài suàn shénme guānxi?
items.en: I'd like to know: what are we to each other now?

items.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, gōutōng hěn zhòngyào.
items.en: Communication is really important to me.

items.text: 我需要一点儿自己的空间，但我还是爱你。
items.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yìdiǎnr zìjǐ de kōngjiān, dàn wǒ háishi ài nǐ.
items.en: I need a little space of my own, but I still love you.

items.text: 我们在一起两年了，打算搬到一起住。
items.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yìqǐ liǎng nián le, dǎsuàn bān dào yìqǐ zhù.
items.en: We've been together two years and plan to move in together.

items.text: 阿姨好，叔叔好！常听小明提起你们。
items.pinyin: Āyí hǎo, shūshu hǎo! Cháng tīng Xiǎo Míng tíqǐ nǐmen.
items.en: Hello, Auntie! Hello, Uncle! Xiaoming often talks about you.
Just a small gift. Please accept it.

items.pinyin: Wǒ lái bāng nín shōushi ba.
items.en: Let me help you tidy up.

items.pinyin: Zhōurì qù tā jiā chī fàn.
items.en: On Sunday we're having dinner at his family's.
You have such a sweet smile.
Chatting with you is so much fun.

items.pinyin: Nǐ de gēdān pǐnwèi búcuò a!
Nǐ shì zài liáo wǒ ma?
Wǒ juéde tā duì nǐ yǒu yìsi.

items.text: 不知道他是喜欢我，还是只是客气。
items.pinyin: Bù zhīdào tā shì xǐhuan wǒ, háishi zhǐshì kèqi.
items.en: I don't know if he likes me or is just being polite.
He replies instantly, so you might have a chance.

items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng duō liǎojiě nǐ yìdiǎnr.
items.en: I'd like to get to know you better.

items.text: 你一直这样，还是只对我这样？
items.pinyin: Nǐ yìzhí zhèyàng, háishi zhǐ duì wǒ zhèyàng?
items.en: Are you always like this, or just with me?
Ooh, a little full of yourself 😏

items.pinyin: Wǒ yòu yíng le, fú bu fú?
Bié zhuāng le, wǒ kàndào nǐ xiào le.
items.en: Stop pretending, I saw you smile.

items.pinyin: Zhè cì nǐ qiàn wǒ yì bēi kāfēi.
items.en: This time you owe me a coffee.

items.pinyin: Hǎo ba, zhè cì suàn nǐ yíng.
items.en: Fine, I'll give you this one.

items.text: 你能推荐一下吗？看你挺懂的。
items.pinyin: Nǐ néng tuījiàn yíxià ma? Kàn nǐ tǐng dǒng de.
items.en: Could you recommend something? You seem to know your stuff.

items.text: 你知道我的缺点是什么吗？缺点你。
items.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào wǒ de quēdiǎn shì shénme ma? Quē diǎn nǐ.
items.en: Know what my flaw (缺点) is? Missing (缺) a bit (点) of you.

items.text: 你累不累？你在我脑子里跑了一整天了。
items.pinyin: Nǐ lèi bu lèi? Nǐ zài wǒ nǎozi li pǎo le yì zhěng tiān le.
items.en: Aren't you tired? You've been running through my mind all day.

items.text: 我觉得你今天有点儿怪……怪好看的。
items.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ jīntiān yǒudiǎnr guài… guài hǎokàn de.
items.en: I think you're a bit strange (怪) today… strangely (怪) good-looking.

items.pinyin: Hǎo tǔ a, dànshì nǐ xiào le!
Wǒ néng qǐng nǐ hē yì bēi ma?
items.en: Can I buy you a drink?

items.pinyin: Liǎng zhēn yì jiǎ, nǐ xiān lái.
items.en: Two truths and a lie, you go first 😉

items.text: 你那张爬山的照片让我好奇，是在哪儿拍的？
items.pinyin: Nǐ nà zhāng páshān de zhàopiàn ràng wǒ hàoqí, shì zài nǎr pāi de?
items.en: Your hiking photo has me curious. Where was it taken?

items.text: 我还在想昨晚我们聊的天🙈
items.pinyin: Wǒ hái zài xiǎng zuówǎn wǒmen liáo de tiān.
items.en: I'm still thinking about our chat last night 🙈
items.say: 我还在想昨晚我们聊的天。

items.pinyin: Zǎo'ān, zuówǎn shuì de hǎo ma?
Nǐ hái qiàn wǒ yì jú táiqiú.
items.en: You still owe me a game of pool 😏

items.text: 跟你聊得很开心，能加个微信吗？
items.pinyin: Gēn nǐ liáo de hěn kāixīn, néng jiā ge Wēixìn ma?
items.en: I've really enjoyed talking with you. Can I add you on WeChat?

items.text: 要不要换个地方接着聊？
items.pinyin: Yào bu yào huàn ge dìfang jiēzhe liáo?
items.en: Want to go somewhere else and keep talking?

items.text: 很高兴认识你，希望还能再见面。
items.pinyin: Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ, xīwàng hái néng zài jiànmiàn.
items.en: Really nice to meet you. I hope we can meet again.

items.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, shì wǒ wùhuì le.

items.text: 没关系，跟你聊天很愉快。
items.pinyin: Méi guānxi, gēn nǐ liáotiān hěn yúkuài.
items.en: No worries, it was lovely chatting with you.
Sorry to trouble you / thanks for your help.

quiz.q: Someone greets you with 你吃了吗？ A natural answer is…
Business cards are given and received…
options: by sliding them across the table

quiz.q: To call someone over in China, you wave with your palm facing…
Why shouldn't you stand chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice?
options: It looks like incense at a funeral

quiz.q: Tipping in restaurants in mainland China and Taiwan is…
When toasting an older person, you hold your glass…

items.en: Wishing you wealth, now hand over the red envelope! (a joke)

items.text: 中秋节快乐！我们一起吃月饼吧。
items.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié kuàilè! Wǒmen yìqǐ chī yuèbing ba.
items.en: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Let's eat mooncakes together.

items.text: 端午节我们吃粽子，看龙舟。
items.pinyin: Duānwǔjié wǒmen chī zòngzi, kàn lóngzhōu.
items.en: At the Dragon Boat Festival we eat zongzi and watch the boat races.
For New Year I'm going back to my hometown.

quiz.q: Money in red envelopes (红包) is given…
Why is a clock a bad gift?
options: 送钟 sounds like 送终 (attending a death)

items.en: Sorry to bother you for a moment.
Let me think about it. (often a polite no)

quiz.q: A colleague answers your plan with 我考虑一下. It often means…
买 (mǎi) and 卖 (mài) differ only by tone. They mean…

items.pinyin: Liù liù liù, nǐ tài lìhai le!
items.en: Six six six, you're amazing! (online slang)
Here's a like for you! (well done)

items.pinyin: Zhè jiā huǒguō yǒngyuǎn de shén!
items.en: This hotpot place is the GOAT!
At the weekend I just want to lie flat and do nothing.

options: doing the minimum instead of chasing success

quiz.q: 超讚的 sounds especially like someone from…
